Preparing the building studio

Procedural buildings · shared floor plans · local projects



ArchitectureWorks / getting started
Build the place. Tell the story.
Start from a house, or choose Blank site. Use Draw room and drag rectangles in Floor plan. Adjacent rooms share walls. Switch to Furnish to place furniture.
1 / 2 / 3 / 4Exterior / cutaway / floor plan / walk through
V / B / D / WSelect / draw room / place door / place window
Drag / right dragOrbit / pan in 3D. Move selection / pan in Floor plan.
Scroll / F / HZoom / frame building / focus mode
R / Delete / EscRotate furnishing / delete selection / cancel
Ctrl/Cmd Z / Shift ZUndo / redo
Ctrl/Cmd SSave editable project
Walk throughWASD move, drag to look, Shift faster, E open nearest door, Esc return. Basic wall collision and stair-ramp preview.
Add floor copies the top floor and creates a starter stair shaft. A room at least 3 × 4.8 m is required. The editor supports up to three stories; changing lower footprints does not enforce structural support.
Save project preserves editable room, opening, and furniture data. Export building provides a textured GLB, a WorldWorks prefab with collision descriptors and hooks, or a viewport PNG. The preview landscape is excluded from model exports.
This is a game-asset authoring tool, not CAD, construction documentation, code compliance, structural analysis, or a production physics engine. Windows are transparent materials, not simulated refraction. Nonrectangular roof wings are generated separately; roof intersections are not boolean-joined.
Standalone 3D uses Three.js r180 when the CDN can load; otherwise it uses the built-in WebGL2 preview. A blocked GPU still permits floor-plan editing. The source package includes a renderer-sharing WorldWorks module; it does not automatically merge existing HTML engines.


Export / local files
A building ready to travel.
Keep the project JSON for editing. Use GLB for rendering and the prefab JSON for game-world metadata.
GLB is a rendered asset, not a replacement for your editable ArchitectureWorks project. Collision descriptors require your host physics adapter.
